text: {"assertions":["A dropped frames bug in the websocket session was reproduced by holding a socket open through a network flap.","The dropped frames bug manifested as missing frames in the client sequence, occurring specifically for records with non-ASCII names.","The root cause of the dropped frames was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation in realtime/ws/session.ts.","The fix involved prefetching the relation in a single query, implemented in PR #2341 on branch fix/dropped-frames-1.","The backlog cleared 4 minutes after the dropped frames fix was deployed.","The realtime websocket session code is written in TypeScript with test coverage in realtime/ws/session.test.ts."]}
